title: SGLang-Omni stage DAG, process replicas and transport lifetime
summary: Map normal, fan-in, streaming and terminal edges separately while preserving request identity, abort state and sender-buffer ownership.

zh-CN.title: SGLang-Omni 阶段 DAG、进程副本与传输生命周期
zh-CN.summary: 分别梳理普通、汇聚、流式和终止边，保持请求身份、取消状态与发送缓冲区所有权。

conditions: Resolve the exact PipelineConfig, model variant, process placement and device topology.
Annotate scheduler, process replica, TP ranks, tensor device and state owner per stage.

recommendations: Trace admission through terminal merge and cancellation before changing placement or buffering; a process replica copies its stages and is not TP.
Keep shared local objects read-only and preserve the appropriate CUDA IPC or relay completion lifetime; only active fan-in sources should block completion.
validation_plan: Test ordered chunks before EOS, aborted preparation/late outputs, fan-in completion and repeated cleanup.
Validate local versus cross-process/native transport behavior on the actual placement and hardware.
limitations: This revision has no generic public transport selector and no supported OmniScheduler.event_loop_overlap toggle.
Stage-list order need not equal execution order; transport implementation files do not imply selectable production support.
This indexed abstract links to the complete bilingual skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
